name: fix-v29-fk-before-drop-column
title: Fix V29 migration: drop FK before dropping column
description: V29 fails at runtime because it tries to DROP COLUMN selection_group_id while a foreign key constraint (fk_ppo_group) still references it. MySQL 8 refuses this. Fix: drop the FK constraint before dropping the column.
acceptance: V29 migration drops fk_ppo_group foreign key before attempting ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN
./harness/harness.sh exit 0
App boots successfully with `task run` after the fix

name: public-jwks-endpoint
title: Public JWKS endpoint at /.well-known/jwks.json
description: Expose the public half of the API's signing keys in RFC 7517 JWKS format at GET /.well-known/jwks.json. Supports single-key (backwards compatible) and multi-key rotation via env vars. Adds deterministic kid derivation (SHA-256 of public key DER), kid header on all generated JWTs, and a Nimbus JWKSource-based JwtEncoder. No new dependencies needed.
acceptance: JwtConfigValidator extended to read single-key and multi-key env vars without breaking existing deployments
Every RSAKey built in SecurityConfig carries a kid derived by JwkKeyIdDeriver.from(publicKey)
JwtServiceImpl includes the kid JWS header on every generated token (access, refresh, TFA)
GET /.well-known/jwks.json returns RFC 7517-compliant JSON, public material only (no d, p, q, etc.)
Endpoint is in permitAll() of SecurityConfig (production branch) — reachable without auth
Content-Type: application/jwk-set+json
Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600 + ETag set
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header present
CORS open for this path
ProblemDetail (RFC 7807) returned on 503 when no keys configured
./harness/harness.sh exits 0
